slides.title: Year 2 Is Different
slides.content: Year 1 was about building foundations. Year 2 is about: Final assessments. Portfolios. Final Major Projects (FMP). Industry placements. Preparing progression routes.

slides.title: Gaps Compound
slides.content: Any weaknesses carried from Year 1 become bigger. Examples: Missing skills. Incomplete portfolio work. Poor organisation. Lower attendance. Year 2 gives much less room for error.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Gaps Compound'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Gaps Compound.

slides.title: The Final Fuse
slides.content: Missed work hurts most near assessment deadlines. Students often struggle because they are: Catching up on old work. Producing new work at the same time. The most effective strategy remains planning time in advance and using free periods productively.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following is a key point about 'The Final Fuse'?
exercise.explanation: This is a key point from the section on The Final Fuse.

slides.title: Seek Opportunity in Year 2
slides.content: Progression should become active. Examples: Applying for university. Applying for apprenticeships. Building a portfolio. Completing placement evidence. Publishing work online. Developing industry experience.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Seek Opportunity in Year 2'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Seek Opportunity in Year 2.

slides.title: The Year 2 Confidence Trap
slides.content: Trap 1: Coasting: "Year 1 was fine; I don't need to change anything." Trap 2: The Wall: Struggling but not asking for help. The solution to both: recognise the issue early, ask for support early.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following is a key point about 'The Year 2 Confidence Trap'?
exercise.explanation: This is a key point from the section on The Year 2 Confidence Trap.

slides.title: Attendance Matters More in Year 2
slides.content: Attendance supports: Final assessment success. Understanding grade boundaries. Staff references. Industry and university applications. Visibility of your effort and development.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Attendance Matters More in Year 2'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Attendance Matters More in Year 2.

slides.title: Barriers Still Need Support
slides.content: Common barriers include: Burnout. Pressure and stress. Financial difficulties. Family responsibilities. Health needs. Neurodivergence. The key message is the same: tell someone early.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Barriers Still Need Support'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Barriers Still Need Support.

slides.title: Focus on One Habit
slides.content: A single practical action is more useful than multiple vague plans. Examples: Use one free period effectively. Resolve unfinished Year 1 work. Take a progression step. Discuss a barrier with staff.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Focus on One Habit'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Focus on One Habit.
